title: Srebrenica genocide
summary: Bosnian Serb forces under Ratko Mladić killed more than 8,000 Bosniak men and boys in a UN 'safe area' and forcibly expelled 25,000 to 30,000 Bosniaks, mostly women and children.
why: International courts (ICTY 2004, ICJ 2007) ruled it genocide, the first legally recognised genocide in Europe since 1945.
